screens.screen: branch orders queue (open/closed state, per-order 'change to next status' and reject actions, special-order tag, Cupertino tab bar)
order details for staff (amounts and commissions, status steps, chat and call customer / shop / driver)
order chat between customer, staff and driver

notes: Same brand colours as the other Wasselak apps; no font is bundled so it is drawn with the iOS system Arabic font (SF Arabic). This app uses a CupertinoTabBar; it is drawn for a regular (non-manager) employee, i.e. four tabs — a manager also gets a first 'الادارات' tab, which is shown in the Admin app instead. In order details the contact tiles use a default CircleAvatar with a white icon: under Material 3 its background is the theme's primaryContainer (#F3F3F3), so the icons are faint in the real app too; drawn as the code specifies. The payment method is printed untranslated by this screen ('cash'). Phone numbers are fictional. The 'مفتوح' label is the AppBar leading widget, so it sits tight against the edge as in the code.
